title: GKE 1.33 is past end of standard support
summary: GKE 1.33 reached the end of standard support on 2026-08-12 and is in extended support until 2027-06-12. GKE provides up to 24 months of support per minor version: about 14 months of standard support and the rest as extended support in the Extended channel.

constraints: GKE upgrades one minor version at a time and may auto-upgrade a cluster whose version reaches end of support.
Only a cluster in the Extended channel keeps receiving security patches past the end of standard support.
Node pools and the control plane must be on compatible versions, so raise both in the same change.

steps.title: Raise the control-plane version
steps.instructions: Set min_master_version to the release in the replacement, or remove it so the cluster follows its release channel.

steps.title: Raise the node pools
steps.instructions: Raise google_container_node_pool version, or let the release channel manage it, so nodes match the control plane.

steps.title: Remove APIs the new version deleted
steps.instructions: Read the Kubernetes deprecation guide for every minor version crossed and replace removed API versions in manifests and Helm charts before applying.

verification.purpose: Initialize without touching remote state and check that the configuration is valid.
Review the plan and confirm the control-plane and node-pool changes are the intended ones.
Confirm the control plane reports the new version.
Confirm kubectl and the API server agree on the version.
